info.name: Cerqle Hub API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Cerqle Hub REST API.

Includes Mobile Staff App API, Mobile Master Email Inbox, and Developer Tools API.

### 🔐 Authentication Flow
1. Run the **01. Authentication & Profile -> Login (Saves Token)** request with your credentials.
2. A Postman test script automatically extracts `token` and saves it to the `{bearer_token}` collection variable.
3. All protected requests automatically inherit Bearer token authentication.

request.description: Public login endpoint for staff. Exchanges email & password for Sanctum personal access token. Automatically saves the token to {{bearer_token}} in Collection Variables for all protected endpoints.

console.log('✅ Bearer token successfully saved to collection variable: bearer_token');
console.warn('⚠️ No token found in login response payload');
